notes.problem: The showstopper frame has none of the world its craft plan names. There is no warehouse, no prairie and no horizon, only an empty court running into grey, so the lit doorway has nothing to glow against.
notes.fix: Add the warehouse and the black Blackland horizon on the lower third behind the tractor, and darken the shelf cloud over it so the lit doorway is the frame's one light.

notes.problem: The named showstopper cover has no world. The court's grid runs into a flat grey band with no warehouse, prairie or horizon object. An unexplained dark rectangle and a pale streak sit at the right edge, cast by something off frame. The bare-floor focal is a sliver.
notes.fix: Place the kit warehouse and a fence line with Blackland field on the horizon at about y 900 (display), lost in the green-grey haze. Delete or move the off-frame occluder casting the rectangle at the right edge. Add TXT.contact oil stains and tyre scuffs on the court under the tandems.

notes.problem: This is the showstopper and cover, but the van sits on a tiled apron in a featureless grey-brown haze with no warehouse, prairie or horizon. The tractor's cab is a dark blob, and the 7 bare places, which are the whole point of 'Not closed yet', are not visible at 432 px.
notes.fix: Put the kit warehouse dock wall and a black-prairie horizon in the haze on the lower third behind the van. Lower and swing the camera toward the doorway axis so the bare oak floor between the ember beam and the doors is an area at thumb size.

notes.problem: The roofless van sits alone on a featureless brown tiled plane that fades into a grey band. There is no court dressing and no horizon, so the counting frame reads as an object in a void.
notes.fix: Raise the pitch so the horizon sits on the upper third behind the hook, and put the chassis warehouse with dock doors, two parked trailers and light poles in haze across it.

notes.problem: Product shot on an infinite tiled floor. There is no horizon content, the top fades into murk, and the van's near wall is missing as well as its roof, so it reads as an open-sided toy.
notes.fix: Lower the crane pitch until a horizon carrying the hub building and the field sits on the upper third behind the type. Put the near wall back so only the roof is lifted. Scatter a second parked trailer and apron stains around the rig so it stands in a yard.

notes.problem: A roofless van on a tiled void reads as a toy diorama. No horizon is in frame despite the storyboard's own risk note, and the court has no wear.
notes.fix: Pitch the crane up until the warehouse and prairie horizon sit on the upper third behind the hook. Add oil stains and tyre scuffs to the court so the van stands on a real truck court.

notes.problem: At this crop the kit tractor reads as a primitive model: a blocky hood, a flat unlit black windscreen, no road film. A tree is clipped at the left edge.
notes.fix: Pull the chase camera back until the cab is about 60 percent of the frame width, with the lane and a fencerow behind. Give the glass an environment-reflective material, apply TXT.weather grime to the lower door and steps, and remove the clipped tree.

notes.problem: Close crop makes the primitive tractor the zoom subject: a rounded-box hood, a flat grille plate, half-disc emissive headlamps and blob mirror pods. A tree is clipped against the left edge.
notes.fix: Pull back to a medium three-quarter at 6 to 8 m so the sensor bar reads and the low-poly hood is not the detail budget, or bevel and panel the hood and grille geometry. Move the cedar elm fully into frame or fully out.

notes.problem: The tractor hood is a clay-smooth primitive with no panel seams, rivets or road film. The planned focal (roof sensor bar and mirror pod) is a small strip, and a half tree is cut by the left edge.
notes.fix: Crop tighter on the roof sensor bar and mirror pod per the CRAFT PLAN, pushing the bare hood out of the bottom of the frame. Remove or move the clipped tree, and add road-film grime low on the door and hood.

notes.problem: The load face is identical untextured carton cubes on a bare court, and the doorway is the only built object in frame.
notes.fix: Give the carton_stack seeded lean and printed flute edges, and add the court's dock wall and a parked trailer edge in haze beyond the van's roofline.

notes.problem: Sawtooth shadow artifact down the left carton column (display x 460-580, y 860-1480). The van sits on a void court, and the folded doors the storyboard calls for are not visible.
notes.fix: Fix the shadow-map bias, or raise VSM radius and resolution, on the stack geometry. Show the swung doors folded flat against the sides at the frame edges. Add the hub building on the haze line behind the roof.

notes.problem: No tandem shows under the floor, so the van appears to stand on its light boxes and ICC bar. A sawtooth shadow-map artifact runs down the left carton column, and the apron behind is void.
notes.fix: Raise the eye slightly and pull back so the rear tandem and its contact shadow sit under the floor. Fix the interior shadow aliasing with a tighter shadow camera or higher VSM resolution for this frame, and put the dock wall behind the van's roofline.

notes.problem: The kit person stands well clear of the van on an empty court. The floor reads at her head, not her waist as the storyboard planned, and the van's interior is the only depth.
notes.fix: Move the camera to 1.2 m, 5 m off, and stand her against the ICC bumper beside the bare floor so the floor reads at her waist. Put the warehouse wall in haze behind her.

notes.problem: The kit person is a hands-on-hips mannequin standing in front of the bumper. The lower-left quarter is empty concrete, the van flank goes cold blue-grey against the deck's warm key, and the stack edge carries sawtooth shadow acne.
notes.fix: Move the camera about 3 m right and lower so the van and person fill the frame and the empty lower-left court is cropped out. Switch the figure to a relaxed standing pose beside the open door at the bumper. Raise the VSM shadow bias/normalBias to clear the sawtooth.

notes.problem: The van's material turns cool blue-grey against the warm white of every other frame. The kit person stands hands-on-hips facing the lens as a cutout, and the court is void.
notes.fix: Use frame 1's van material and white balance on frame 9. Turn the person three-quarter toward the open doors as if reading the load, and put the dock wall and horizon behind the van.

notes.problem: A stray yellow polygon lies on the shoulder at bottom right, a render artifact in an otherwise strong world frame.
notes.fix: Find and remove the stray ground decal or mesh placed at the lower right shoulder.

notes.problem: A flat yellow polygon decal floats on the right shoulder (display x 1400-1600, y 1560-1760). The delineator posts merge into the vanishing point instead of visibly stopping short of the horizon.
notes.fix: Delete the stray ground decal. Shorten the post spacing so the 89th post stands clearly before the horizon, with open shoulder beyond it.

notes.problem: A flat yellow polygon decal floats on the right verge in the lower right, an obvious render artifact in the deck's best world frame.
notes.fix: Delete the stray decal mesh or replace it with a grass tuft patch matching the verge.

notes.problem: Toy cutaway. Identical tiled carton texture runs the full length, the floor tapes are pale blocks hanging below the sill across the tyres, an ember bar floats at ground level, and the bottom 40% is dead court.
notes.fix: Lay the three tapes flat on the oak floor inside the section and end the leaders at the sill. Put the ember bar at the load face only. Raise the van to the lower third and tighten the label stack under it. Seed per-stack variation in carton texture and lean.

notes.problem: The near-wall cutaway with identical repeated carton tiles reads as a toy, a ghost tractor is sliced by the left edge, and all five labels pile into the lower right corner.
notes.fix: Crop the tractor fully out at the kingpin and seed variation into the carton stacks (lean, flute edges, tape). Let the cut aluminium edge read as metal, and add the dock and horizon behind the section.
